Thanks so much for your patience!
Gao J

edu>
> Subject: Re: [AMBER] Using pytraj with jupyter notebook
> To: "amber.ambermd.org" <amber.ambermd.
org>
> Message-ID:
> 	<MWHPR05MB29116E10A2E3EC50B01DFC25F98D0.MWHPR05MB2911.
namprd05.prod.outlook.com>
>
> Content-Type: text/plain; charset="iso-8859-1"
>
> Hello everyone,
>
> I am new to AMBER and i am trying to use pytraj.
>
> I am getting this error -"importError: dynamic module does not define module export function (PyInit_topology_objects)" when trying to use pytraj ( import pytraj) and wish to ask about what i should do to fix this?
>
>
> thanks,
> amith
>
>
> ------------------------------
>
> Message: 2
> Date: Sun, 31 May 2020 19:43:39 -0400
> From: Hai Nguyen <nhai.qn.gmail.com>
> Subject: Re: [AMBER] Using pytraj with jupyter notebook
> To: AMBER Mailing List <amber.ambermd.
org>
> Message-ID:
> 	<CAFNMPM-9HXYPZCAG5QWYhM8_S=Kte+_LcH5aq7rCG6PXC1e2Dg.mail.
gmail.com>
> Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"
>
> On Sun, May 31, 2020 at 3:44 PM Rangarajan, Amith <Amith.Rangarajan.ucsf.
edu>
> wrote:
>
> > Hello everyone,
> >
> > I am new to AMBER and i am trying to use pytraj.
> >
> > I am getting this error -"importError: dynamic module does not define
> > module export function (PyInit_topology_objects)" when trying to use pytraj
> > ( import pytraj) and wish to ask about what i should do to fix this?
> >
> >
> >
> hi, it seems like you're using different python version for pytraj (saying
> use python 2 for pytraj that was compiled with python3).
>
> - which python version are you using?
> - In the notebook: import sys; print(sys.version_info)
>
> If the versions mismatch, make sure to launch the notebook with the same
> python version used for compiling pytraj.
>
> Please see the old thread: http://archive.ambermd.org/202004/0237.html
> Hai
>
>
> > thanks,
> > amith
> >
